name: tilttek/collections-bundle
description: Collectibles for Symfony on tilttek/collections: the catalog in configuration or the database; copies, sets, packs, chosen dice and the item of the day in Doctrine DBAL; its activity projection; the inventory tilttek/exchange trades through; dice appearance for tilttek/dice-bundle; events, Twig templates, commands, a member's export and erasure

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the collections' tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/almanac: For items of the day on computed dates, such as Easter or the fourth Thursday of November
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's collection with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that generate the calendar, give a copy and show an album
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the templates of the album, the item of the day and the odds of a pack
suggest.tilttek/activity-bundle: To keep the journal of activity the item of the day is claimed on, and catch its projection up live or by a command
suggest.tilttek/dice-bundle: To roll the dice of a set a member owns and chose, through the appearance this bundle provides
suggest.tilttek/exchange-bundle: To let members trade the copies of their collections, through the inventory this bundle provides
